uncited: The method optimizes a set of 3D Gaussian primitives $P$ to minimize a composite loss function while managing the stability of learned features and MLP weights.
- Initial set of Gaussian primitives (position, scale, rotation, opacity, features).
- Optimized Gaussian primitives and associated MLP weights.
Each primitive $i$ has fields: position $\mathbf{p}_i$, scale $\mathbf{s}_i$, rotation $\mathbf{q}_i$, opacity $\alpha_i$, feature vector $\mathbf{f}_i$.
**Initialization:** Initialize Gaussian primitives and MLP weights.
Render the scene using the current Gaussian primitives and MLP weights.
